thread:
Jorge: Quick question — finishing onboarding checklist and ran into two blockers: 1) I need KMS access for local testing of the embeddings service, do I request a key or is there a dev-only workflow? 2) MDM shows 'Pending: device hardening required' — what exact steps do I need to clear that?

Ava (People Ops): Welcome Jorge! For KMS, request via the access ticket form: https://intranet/redwood/access-requests fill the 'crypto' template and tag @Priya. For local dev we usually provide a dev key scoped to sandbox projects, but that requires manager approval.

Samir (IT): Jorge — for the MDM pending state you'll need to finish FileVault + password policy + disk encryption. Steps: 1) Open Company Portal > Devices > Enroll 2) Run the enrollment profile. If you're on mac run:
```
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
# then verify with:
profiles status -type enrollment
```
If that fails paste the last 10 lines of /var/log/mdm_enroll.log and I'll take a look.

Priya (Security): Re: KMS access — tag your manager in the ticket and include the service scope (e.g., embeddings-sandbox). We approve dev keys with a scoped expiry (30 days) and audit tag. Also, phishing sims are auto-enrolled across the org; you can't opt-out but you can mark personal devices in the portal if this is not your work machine. If you see anything odd, use the Report Phish button or file a rapid incident.

EnrollBot: [automated] PhishSim enrollment triggered for jorge@redwood.ai. Campaign: Q2-ScenarioA. You will receive the first test email within 48 hours.

Jorge: Thanks — submitting the access request now. For the MDM step, where do I find /var/log/mdm_enroll.log?

Samir (IT): It’s on the Mac under /var/log. If you prefer GUI: Company Portal > Support > Diagnostics > Download enrollment log. If you already opened the ticket include the log there. Also noted — ticket template will auto-attach your device serial if you submit from the corporate network.

Jorge: Submitted ticket #INC-6072 and attached the enrollment log. Also tagged @Priya as requested.

Priya (Security): Saw the ticket, thanks. I’ll review the requested scopes and set a 30-day dev key if the manager thumbs up arrives. Quick tip: avoid checking in real prod keys into your repo — use the Secrets Manager snippet in docs.

Ava (People Ops): If you want, I can hop on a 10-min call with Samir to unblock the MDM step. :wave:

Jorge: That'd be great — thanks everyone!
